question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a brown ball, Bob has a black ball, and Claire has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Finally, Alice and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) brown ball
(B) black ball
(C) gold ball
solution:
Each row lists the ball colors held by Alice, Bob, and Claire, in that order.
Initial: brown | black | gold
1. Bob–Claire: brown | gold | black
2. Alice–Claire: black | gold | brown
3. Alice–Claire: brown | gold | black
Alice has the brown ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
